resources.string: Enter the address of your partstrack-web server, as you open it in a browser. The phone needs to reach it, on the local network or through a VPN.
Needed for changes. Create one on the server with \'partstrack token add phone\'. Without a token, the app only shows the inventory.
The saved token can\'t be read any more, because the key that protects it is gone. Enter it again.
The address starts with http://, so the token travels unencrypted. Use it only on a network you trust, or through a VPN.
The token couldn\'t be stored securely on this phone, so nothing was saved. Try again, or save without a token.
Connected to partstrack %1$s with the token \'%2$s\'. You can make changes.
Connected to partstrack %1$s. Without a token, the app only shows the inventory.
The token \'%2$s\' is valid, but this server (partstrack %1$s) shows a read-only copy, so changes can\'t be saved.
This server runs partstrack %1$s, which can\'t check API tokens. The app needs a newer partstrack.
The server doesn\'t accept this token. %1$s
Can\'t reach the server. Check the address, and that the phone is on the right network or VPN. %1$s
Something answered at this address, but it isn\'t a partstrack server with an API (partstrack 1.3.0 or later).
The server answered with an error: %1$s
Read-only: no API token is set.
